compatibility_policy.patch: Documentation and validation corrections that do not change accepted data.
compatibility_policy.minor: Backward-compatible optional fields, schemas, or enumerations.
compatibility_policy.major: Removed fields, changed meanings, incompatible constraints, or incompatible enumeration changes.

notes: Public artifacts and durable analytical data are JSON-family only.
Observed measurements, model estimates, and public projections are separate record types.
This release locks the initial contract before acquisition and application scaffolding.
